$comment: Lighthouse CI, DESKTOP emulation. The second half of AC-LAND-9: `/` desktop performance at
least 95. Separate file because a Lighthouse run carries one form factor and one throttling
profile; everything else is the mobile config's reasoning, unchanged.
`preset: desktop` is the tool's own desktop profile (1350x940, 1x CPU, no request throttling
beyond the desktop defaults). It is not a hand-tuned set of numbers chosen to clear the bar.
Only performance is asserted here. Accessibility, best practices and SEO are properties of
the document rather than the viewport, and the mobile run already holds them to 95/95/90;
asserting them twice would report the same fact twice.
